reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: 24.1 gives Customer an unconditional affiliate/successor (merger, reorganization, acquisition, sale of substantially all assets) carve-out; 24.2 restricts Vendor assignment (including by change of control) to Customer's reasonable consent and bars assignment to a direct competitor; 24.4 expressly negates any Vendor termination, suspension, repricing, acceleration or service-reduction right on Customer's change of control.
Section 24.3's mutual reasonable-consent standard for other assignments matches the fallback and does not undercut the preferred position.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or comment was proposed and the rendered text is unchanged from the original; the deterministic check for the successor/affiliate carve-out passes.
No walk-away features (blanket Customer assignment ban, Vendor CoC termination/re-pricing right) are present.
